Using the FY2025 audited deposited-property base instead (total assets S$9,979M directly held + JV share): with gross debt of S$3,757M (per FY2025 statements) + S$402.8M perpetuals over S$9,979M total assets = 41.7%; using the proportionate-consolidation AUM base of S$11.8B (which matches the way MAS allows aggregate leverage to be computed with proportionate JV inclusion) and proportionately-included gross debt S$4.74B + perps S$0.40B / S$11.8B = 43.6%. Conservative estimate: 44.2% (uses the higher end of MAS proportionate methodology including S$402.8M perpetuals). Manager does not publish a perpetuals-inclusive aggregate leverage figure directly. Incl-perps gearing = 40.2% + S$402.8M perps / S$7,853M deposited property = 45.3%. (FY2025 reported leverage of 47.9% included a transitory equity bridge loan repaid 20 Jan 2026.)
K71U.forward_dpu_guidance: Manager (Chua Hsien Yang): Keppel REIT anchored by robust underlying performance & favourable market fundamentals (Singapore CBD Grade A average signing rent S$13.26 psf pm vs S$11.98 expiring in FY2026 = positive reversion runway). No numeric DPU guidance. Sell-side analysts (DBS, UOB) trimmed FY2026 DPU estimates by 3-5% on cost headwinds; all-in cost of debt rose from 3.2% to 3.8% YoY.
